[Multiple Use and Heat Safe] - This versatile accessory, designed to sit securely on the workstation with anti-slip silicone side strips, can be used as a cutting board for fruits & vegetables, as a drying rack for your dishes, or for any cooking prep work you need. [Space-Saving, Foldable Design] - Quickly and easily roll it up for storage, helping to declutter your kitchen. This design is not only a great way to save space but also easy to clean. It is suitable for both hand washing and machine washing.

[Strong and Sturdy] - Its durable construction will not bend or warp, even when used with heavy cookware; it easily supports up to 70 lbs with all rods in use.

[Multipurpose Drying Rack] - Perfect for air-drying kitchenware such as dishes, mugs, bowls, pans, glasses, cups, plates, cookware, cutlery, saucepans, bottles, and even fruits and vegetables. A must-have kitchen gadget.
[Wide Application] - Suitable for use in the kitchen sink, RV, new home, dormitory, farmhouse, and more.
